parsed.rationale: The software-reported success is supported and covers the outcome unit. The odometry claim gives 6.713746180426389 m, but the recorded sampled XY path distance is 5.713746180426389 m, so the motion unit is not covered. Its sampled-frame scope and distinction from physical arrival are appropriate; the numeric error does not assert a mechanism or physical attainment.
